units.function: Interactive CLI tests connecting board or Agent personas to a deployment, selecting company/Agent, creating an API key and storing profile metadata.
units.dependencyDirection: Runs command registration with mocked board login and HTTP responses, writes real temporary context JSON, but does not exercise auth server or credential-store implementation.
units.keyDataModels: API base, persona, company/Agent identity, API-key ID/name/token response, board approval URL and versioned profile.
units.lifecycle: Health-checks a server, logs in as board, selects scope, creates board/Agent key and records non-Secret profile metadata.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 2/2. Persona flow and absence of raw token in context are useful, but Secret persistence, TLS/origin, scope/audience/expiry, challenge security, rollback/idempotency, cross-tenant denial and cleanup are absent.
units.designRationale: Provide one guided setup path for human-board and Agent automation profiles across remote deployments.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs distinct human and Connector/Agent identities across managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles without sharing product-wide authority.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the persona-scoped profile UX and metadata/Secret separation. Require HTTPS/trusted-origin policy, IdentityPort device/PKCE flow, exact audience/company/capability grants, short expiry/rotation, SecretStore persistence, idempotent issuance with compensating revoke and accountable approval evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: Selecting an Agent and issuing its key under a board session does not identify the accountable human owner or bind approval to exact permissions, purpose and expiry.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 2 passed in combined 7-test run

units.function: Filesystem tests for versioned multi-profile CLI context defaults, upsert/current selection, migration and invalid-value normalization.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls production context store against temporary paths; it does not access credential storage or remote servers.
units.keyDataModels: Context version/current profile, API base, company/persona/Agent metadata and API-key environment-variable name.
units.lifecycle: Reads defaults, writes/patches profiles, selects one, migrates v1 in memory and normalizes whitespace fields.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5. Safe defaults and Secret-name-only profiles are useful; trusted-origin, stale binding cleanup, explicit clears, durable/atomic storage, concurrency/corruption and cleanup are absent.
units.designRationale: Separate CLI defaults for multiple deployments and personas without embedding raw keys in the profile.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS operators and FDE teams need safe switching among customer-local and managed environments without credential or tenant confusion.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the versioned per-profile metadata and environment/SecretStore indirection. Add canonical origin plus token audience, deployment and tenant IDs, persona-binding validation, explicit clear semantics, atomic CAS writes, modes/symlink checks, corruption backup and migration rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: Context metadata is convenience state, not proof of authorization; server-side identity, responsibility and action evidence remain mandatory after profile selection.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 5 passed in combined 7-test run
